task: AlphaGenome Atlas variant-prioritized per-cancer detection (OV, PAAD)
summary: The cfdna-fragmentomics-pipeline has no per-mutation panel to re-rank. The LR classifier is trained on 5-channel fragment-coverage features (DELFI 5Mb/100kb windows + FSD-196), with no variant/SNV calls, no gene-region panel, and no AVI-score input. There is no mutation-level data on which to apply AlphaGenome Variant Impact (AVI) re-ranking. The task as specified cannot be executed on this codebase.

pipeline_is_tumor_naive.quote: HEAD/tumor-naive (this project): the fragmentomics-only classifier that doesn't require patient-specific mutation panels. Contrast with the 'mutation-informed' panel-LLR detector in DeepCatch.

feature_set_has_no_variants.data_dir_contents: data/features/ has no .vcf / .maf / variant.tsv / mutation.tsv / avi.* files

ov_dropped_from_default_cohort.consequence: OV is excluded from the default multiclass_classification.py cohort; it only appears in per_cancer_ov_paad_sweep.py because that script sets keep=set(labels.values()).

synthetic_mutation_channel_documented.quote: The synthetic mutation score is *not* a real mutation model — it's a calibrated stand-in used to ask: 'Given a mutation channel of this quality, does fusion help?'

constraints_evaluated.alphagenome_no_ml_training: Honored by design — no model was trained or modified using AlphaGenome Atlas outputs. The AVI score (or any related feature) was never used as an input to the LR, PCA, or any score transform.
constraints_evaluated.no_avi_model_input: True — the AVI score never appeared in any feature matrix, scaler, PCA component, or LR coefficient. The 'AVI as a feature' interpretation was never instantiated.
constraints_evaluated.alphagenome_package_installed: pip install alphagenome succeeded in the deepcatch venv (v1.2.x). AtlasClient + genome.Variant API confirmed importable. Atlas query requires an authenticated API key; no calls were made.

attempted_approaches_and_blocker.approach: Direct AVI re-ranking of a per-cancer mutation panel
attempted_approaches_and_blocker.blocker: No per-cancer mutation panel exists in the repo. The feature set is windowed coverage only.

attempted_approaches_and_blocker.approach: Window-level 'high-AVI variant density' prior: map each DELFI/FSD window to its genomic interval, query Atlas for AVI scores of variants falling in that interval, weight the window by max-AVI
attempted_approaches_and_blocker.blocker: (a) Requires per-cancer variant lists to define which AVI scores are 'cancer-relevant'. (b) The Atlas API requires an authenticated key; even with a key, generating a per-cancer variant panel from TCGA/COSMIC would itself be inventing data. (c) The AVI-weighted feature would still need to be a model input, violating the 'AVI score cannot be a model input' rule. The Task itself notes the API cannot train models — only the rank is allowed. There is no rank to apply when the feature space is windowed coverage.

attempted_approaches_and_blocker.approach: Pretend that 'panel' refers to the OvR class list (BRCA/CRC/...) and rank classes by an AVI-derived gene-set overlap
attempted_approaches_and_blocker.blocker: This would not test the hypothesis that 'variants with higher AVI carry more cancer signal per mutation than uniformly-tracked mutations' — it would test something completely different, and would also invent the gene-set overlap. Documented in this file and rejected.

honest_bottom_line.did_avi_ranked_panel_beat_uniform_panel: CANNOT BE MEASURED — there is no per-mutation panel to rank.
honest_bottom_line.did_avi_ranking_help_anywhere: CANNOT BE MEASURED — the experiment was not instantiated.
honest_bottom_line.was_no_ml_training_restriction_honored: YES — no model was trained on or modified using AlphaGenome Atlas outputs. The AVI score never reached any training pipeline.
honest_bottom_line.recommendation: The AVI-ranking hypothesis is testable in the deepcatch panel-LLR pipeline (which does use a per-patient TCGA mutation panel), not in this tumor-naive fragmentomics pipeline. See /Users/hermes/deepcatch/src/foundation/model.py and MODEL.md for the panel-LLR system that could carry an AVI-ranked variant panel.

binary_sens99_floor_preserved: N/A — baseline binary_sens99=0.7355 already falls below the stated 0.755 floor; the floor cannot be 'preserved' because it was never met in this cohort. The default multiclass_classification.py cohort drops OV (n=28 < MIN_CLASS_N=30), so the OV/PAAD sweep's binary number is on a different cohort than the v2.2 published reference.

reproducibility.alphagenome_package: pip install alphagenome succeeds; atlas.atlas.AtlasClient is importable.
